note_en: The 把 construction moves the object in front of the verb to show what is done to it: 可以把一个人的记忆和技能复制给另一个人 "can copy one person's memories and skills to another person." English keeps the object after the verb, but Chinese prefers 把 when the verb is followed by something more, here 给另一个人 telling where the memories end up. The text uses it again in 把奶奶留下的记忆芯片放进抽屉.
